title: 'Collaborative Award for Teaching Excellence'
end: October 2024
company: "University of Manchester"
category: hons-awards
date: 2024-10-01

The Collaborative Award for Teaching Excellence (CATE) recognises and rewards collaborative work that has had a demonstrable impact on teaching and learning.

The Library Student Team was nominated for and receives the award for their activities in providing inclusive, accessible support for students since 2013, as well as creating inclusive learning resources, leading workshops, shaping policies, amplifying student voices and fostering a welcoming, supportive environment that is felt across the institution.
